import HartshorneLib.Chapter4ProjectivePullbackPointCoordinates
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4ProjectivePullbackBasePointFree

/-!
# Point separation from a projective pullback isomorphism

An injective projective morphism over an algebraically closed field, together
with an isomorphism `f*O(1) ≅ O(D)`, gives the distinct-point dimension drop in
Hartshorne IV.3.1. A separating hyperplane supplies the required divisor section.
The pulled coordinates need not be a basis of the complete section space.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Opposite TopologicalSpace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
variable {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] [IsProper X.hom]
variable {n : ℕ}

attribute [local instance] MvPolynomial.gradedAlgebra

omit [IsProper X.hom] in
/-- Distinct projective images are separated by a pulled linear combination
in the ordinary fibers of any specified pullback of `O(1)`. -/
theorem exists_fiberEvaluation_eq_zero_ne_zero_of_projectivePullbackIso
    {M : X.left.Modules} (f : X.left ⟶ projectiveSpace k n)
    (hf : f ≫ projectiveSpaceStructureMap k n = X.hom)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj
      (ProjectiveTwist.twistingSheafOne (k := k) (J := Fin (n + 1))) ≅ M)
    (x y : NonGenericPoint X) (hxy : f x.1 ≠ f y.1) :
    ∃ s : Γ(M, ⊤), Scheme.Modules.fiberEvaluation M x.1 s = 0 ∧
      Scheme.Modules.fiberEvaluation M y.1 s ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨c, hx, hy⟩ :=
    ProjectivePullback.exists_linearForm_basicOpen_of_map_ne f hf x y hxy
  let s := ProjectiveTwist.coordinateLinearCombinationOfIso f e
    (fun j => X.left.overAlgebraMap k ⊤ (c j))
  refine ⟨s, ?_, ?_⟩
  · by_contra hne
    exact hx ((ProjectiveTwist.scalarLinearCombinationOfIso_fiber_ne_zero_iff
      f e hf c x.1).mp hne)
  · exact (ProjectiveTwist.scalarLinearCombinationOfIso_fiber_ne_zero_iff
      f e hf c y.1).mpr hy

/-- A projective hyperplane through the first image and away from the second
pulls back to a section of `D-x` that is not a section of `D-y`. -/
theorem exists_section_devissage_x_not_devissage_y_of_projectivePullbackIso
    (D : CurveDivisor k X) (f : X.left ⟶ projectiveSpace k n)
    (hf : f ≫ projectiveSpaceStructureMap k n = X.hom)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj
      (ProjectiveTwist.twistingSheafOne (k := k) (J := Fin (n + 1))) ≅ divisorModule D)
    (x y : X.left) (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (hy : y ≠ genericPoint X.left) (hxy : f x ≠ f y) :
    ∃ s : divisorSections (CurveDivisor.devissageDivisor hx D) ⊤,
      (s : X.left.functionField) ∉
        divisorSections (CurveDivisor.devissageDivisor hy D) ⊤ := by
  obtain ⟨s, hsx, hsy⟩ :=
    exists_fiberEvaluation_eq_zero_ne_zero_of_projectivePullbackIso
      f hf e ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ hxy
  refine ⟨⟨(show divisorSections D ⊤ from s : X.left.functionField),
    (divisorModule_fiberEvaluation_eq_zero_iff hx D s).mp hsx⟩, ?_⟩
  intro hmem
  exact hsy ((divisorModule_fiberEvaluation_eq_zero_iff hy D s).mpr hmem)

/-- An injective projective morphism with twisting-sheaf pullback `O(D)`
forces the two-dimensional section drop at distinct closed points. -/
theorem h0_sub_h0_twoDevissage_eq_two_of_projectivePullbackIso_injective
    (D : CurveDivisor k X) (f : X.left ⟶ projectiveSpace k n)
    (hf : f ≫ projectiveSpaceStructureMap k n = X.hom)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj
      (ProjectiveTwist.twistingSheafOne (k := k) (J := Fin (n + 1))) ≅ divisorModule D)
    (hinj : Function.Injective f)
    (x y : X.left) (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (hy : y ≠ genericPoint X.left) (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.h0 (divisorSheaf D) : ℤ) -
      CategoryTheory.Sheaf.h0 (divisorSheaf (CurveDivisor.devissageDivisor hy
        (CurveDivisor.devissageDivisor hx D))) = 2 := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ :=
    exists_section_devissage_x_not_devissage_y_of_projectivePullbackIso
      D f hf e x y hx hy (fun h => hxy (hinj h))
  have hsecond := (h0_sub_h0_devissage_eq_one_iff_exists_jumpProj_ne_zero hy
    (CurveDivisor.devissageDivisor hx D)).mpr
      ⟨s, (jumpProj_ne_zero_iff_not_mem_divisorSections_devissage hy
        (CurveDivisor.devissageDivisor hx D) s).mpr (fun h =>
          hs ((divisorSections_twoDevissage_le_inf x y hx hy h).2))⟩
  have hfirst := basePointFreeLinearSystem_of_projectivePullbackIso D f e x hx
  omega

/-- The distinct-point half of the intrinsic very-ampleness converse follows
from any closed immersion with twisting-sheaf pullback `O(D)`. -/
theorem h0_sub_h0_twoDevissage_eq_two_of_projectivePullbackIso_isClosedImmersion
    (D : CurveDivisor k X) (f : X.left ⟶ projectiveSpace k n)
    (hf : f ≫ projectiveSpaceStructureMap k n = X.hom)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj
      (ProjectiveTwist.twistingSheafOne (k := k) (J := Fin (n + 1))) ≅ divisorModule D)
    [IsClosedImmersion f]
    (x y : X.left) (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (hy : y ≠ genericPoint X.left) (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.h0 (divisorSheaf D) : ℤ) -
      CategoryTheory.Sheaf.h0 (divisorSheaf (CurveDivisor.devissageDivisor hy
        (CurveDivisor.devissageDivisor hx D))) = 2 :=
  h0_sub_h0_twoDevissage_eq_two_of_projectivePullbackIso_injective D f hf e
    f.isClosedEmbedding.injective x y hx hy hxy

end
end Hartshorne
